justification: The garden tells you things, if you let it: Tyler Warren's part this week is to rest, not to play, and I will not pretend a man marked Out is merely resting his eyes for the sake of a tidy lineup card. So Barner takes the vine this week, not because a number told me to, but because the alternative was never really a choice at all — a wizard does not hand the castle's keys to the office over a point or two of pride. Everything else is exactly where it was and exactly where it means to be: Taylor and Emanuel Wilson carrying the ground game, Pickens, Olave, and Garrett Wilson doing what receivers do, Goff throwing into a Lions home game that asks nothing difficult of him, Shrader and the Denver defense rounding out a lineup that does not need my help today. Maura will bring her scoreboard and her certainty; I will bring patience, and we shall see which one is still useful in December.
